description: This header defines classes related to dynamic tensor shape handling in a lazy evaluation context for PyTorch, including SizeNode and related size operation nodes for tracing and graph construction.

classes.name: SizeNode
classes.description: Represents the result of calling `size` on a Tensor, subclassing TsNode and DimensionNode, providing methods to retrieve static values, check for symbolic (dynamic) values, and generate string representations.

classes.name: SizeAdd
classes.description: Represents the addition operation on size nodes, subclassing TsNode and DimensionNode.

classes.name: SizeMul
classes.description: Represents the multiplication operation on size nodes, subclassing TsNode and DimensionNode.

classes.name: SizeDiv
classes.description: Represents the division operation on size nodes, subclassing TsNode and DimensionNode.

methods.name: SizeNode
methods.description: Constructor for SizeNode which takes an input value and a dimension index.

methods.name: getStaticValue
methods.description: Returns the static value of the size node if determinable.

methods.name: isSymbolic
methods.description: Checks if the size node is symbolic (not statically known).

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the size node.

ctags.name: SizeAdd
ctags.pattern: /^class TORCH_API SizeAdd : public TsNode, public DimensionNode {$/

ctags.name: SizeDiv
ctags.pattern: /^class TORCH_API SizeDiv : public TsNode, public DimensionNode {$/

ctags.name: SizeMul
ctags.pattern: /^class TORCH_API SizeMul : public TsNode, public DimensionNode {$/

ctags.name: SizeNode
ctags.pattern: /^class TORCH_API SizeNode : public TsNode, public DimensionNode {$/
